name: 29 · Reported speech · Normal
description: 40 preguntas normales sobre reported speech en contextos SOC y de comunicación con clientes.

questions.question: Yesterday the team said, “We are reviewing the new evidence now.” Today we report: The team said that they ___ the new evidence then.
questions.explanation: Tras said en pasado, el present continuous suele retroceder a past continuous; now cambia a then.
questions.translation: El equipo dijo que estaba revisando las nuevas pruebas en ese momento.

questions.question: On Monday Elena said, “I sent the summary on Friday.” Elena said that she ___ the summary the previous Friday.
questions.explanation: La acción de enviar es anterior al momento pasado de said, por eso usamos past perfect: had sent.
questions.translation: Elena dijo que había enviado el resumen el viernes anterior.

questions.question: At noon the analyst said, “We haven’t received the attachment.” The analyst said that they ___ the attachment by noon.
questions.explanation: El present perfect suele retroceder a past perfect después de un verbo introductor en pasado.
questions.translation: El analista dijo que no habían recibido el archivo adjunto para el mediodía.

questions.question: The coordinator said, “I will call the customer after lunch.” She said that she ___ the customer after lunch.
questions.explanation: En estilo indirecto tras said, will normalmente cambia a would.
questions.translation: La coordinadora dijo que llamaría al cliente después de comer.

questions.question: Marco said, “I can join the briefing at four.” Marco said that he ___ the briefing at four.
questions.explanation: Can suele cambiar a could en estilo indirecto; después de could usamos la forma base join.
questions.translation: Marco dijo que podía unirse a la reunión informativa a las cuatro.

questions.question: The lead said, “We may need another review.” The lead said that they ___ another review.
questions.explanation: May suele retroceder a might; el modal va seguido de la forma base need.
questions.translation: La responsable dijo que quizá necesitarían otra revisión.

questions.question: At 17:55 Sara said, “I must leave now because my shift ends at six.” Sara said that she ___ then.
questions.explanation: Para una obligación situada en ese momento pasado, must suele pasar a had to.
questions.translation: Sara dijo que tenía que marcharse en ese momento.

questions.question: The coordinator says, “The customer update is ready.” The coordinator says that the customer update ___ ready.
questions.explanation: Con un verbo introductor en presente, says, no es necesario retroceder el tiempo: is permanece en presente.
questions.translation: La coordinadora dice que la actualización para el cliente está lista.

questions.topic: Pronouns and time or place references
questions.question: Laura said, “I will review my notes.” Laura said that ___ would review ___ notes.
questions.explanation: Al cambiar de hablante, I pasa a she y my pasa a her.
questions.translation: Laura dijo que revisaría sus notas.

questions.topic: Pronouns and time or place references
questions.question: On Tuesday Ben said, “I am meeting the client today.” Ben said that he was meeting the client ___.
questions.explanation: Cuando se informa más tarde, today suele cambiar a that day.
questions.translation: Ben dijo que se reunía con el cliente ese día.

questions.topic: Pronouns and time or place references
questions.question: On Wednesday the client said, “We will reply tomorrow.” The client said that they would reply ___.
questions.explanation: Tomorrow cambia normalmente a the following day o the next day en estilo indirecto.
questions.translation: El cliente dijo que respondería al día siguiente.

questions.topic: Pronouns and time or place references
questions.question: On Friday the analyst said, “The alert appeared yesterday.” The analyst said that the alert had appeared ___.
questions.explanation: Yesterday suele convertirse en the day before o the previous day.
questions.translation: El analista dijo que la alerta había aparecido el día anterior.

questions.topic: Pronouns and time or place references
questions.question: The manager said, “We will test the new format next week.” The manager said that they would test it ___.
questions.explanation: Next week cambia a the following week cuando desplazamos la referencia temporal.
questions.translation: El responsable dijo que probarían el nuevo formato la semana siguiente.

questions.topic: Pronouns and time or place references
questions.question: This morning Ana said, “I finished the draft last night.” Ana said that she had finished the draft ___.
questions.explanation: Last night se transforma normalmente en the night before.
questions.translation: Ana dijo que había terminado el borrador la noche anterior.

questions.topic: Pronouns and time or place references
questions.question: During the site visit the customer said, “We keep the printed procedures here.” Later we reported that they kept them ___.
questions.explanation: Here cambia a there cuando quien informa ya no está en el mismo lugar.
questions.translation: El cliente dijo que guardaban allí los procedimientos impresos.

questions.topic: Pronouns and time or place references
questions.question: Nora held up two pages and said, “These are the revised sections.” Nora said that ___ were the revised sections.
questions.explanation: These suele cambiar a those al alejarse del contexto original.
questions.translation: Nora dijo que aquellas eran las secciones revisadas.

questions.question: The customer asked, “Is the report ready?” The customer asked ___ the report was ready.
questions.explanation: Las preguntas de sí o no se introducen con if o whether y mantienen orden afirmativo.
questions.translation: El cliente preguntó si el informe estaba listo.

questions.question: The lead asked, “Where are the latest notes?” The lead asked where the latest notes ___.
questions.explanation: En una pregunta indirecta no hay inversión: where + sujeto + verbo.
questions.translation: La responsable preguntó dónde estaban las últimas notas.

questions.question: The client asked me, “Why did the call end early?” The client asked me why the call ___.
questions.explanation: En estilo indirecto eliminamos did y usamos orden afirmativo; el past simple puede retroceder a past perfect.
questions.translation: El cliente me preguntó por qué la llamada había terminado antes de tiempo.

questions.question: The coordinator asked, “Did you send the invitation?” She asked us whether we ___ the invitation.
questions.explanation: Una pregunta en past simple pasa a whether + sujeto + past perfect, sin auxiliar did.
questions.translation: La coordinadora nos preguntó si habíamos enviado la invitación.

questions.question: The customer asked, “When will the next call start?” The customer asked when the next call ___.
questions.explanation: En la pregunta indirecta usamos orden afirmativo y will cambia a would.
questions.translation: El cliente preguntó cuándo empezaría la siguiente llamada.

questions.question: The auditor asked, “Who approved this exception?” The auditor asked who ___ that exception.
questions.explanation: Who ya es el sujeto de la pregunta; en estilo indirecto no añadimos did ni invertimos el orden.
questions.translation: El auditor preguntó quién había aprobado esa excepción.

questions.question: The analyst asked, “How many users are on the call?” The analyst asked how many users ___ on the call.
questions.explanation: Las preguntas indirectas usan orden de oración afirmativa: how many users were...
questions.translation: El analista preguntó cuántos usuarios había en la llamada.

questions.question: Choose the correct reported version of “What does this message mean?”
options: She asked what that message meant.
She asked what did that message mean.
She asked what that message did mean?
She asked that what this message meant.
questions.explanation: Eliminamos does, usamos orden afirmativo y, con asked en pasado, mean pasa a meant.
questions.translation: Preguntó qué significaba aquel mensaje.

questions.question: The client said to me, “Please send the summary before noon.” The client asked me ___ the summary before noon.
questions.explanation: Las peticiones se expresan con ask + persona + to-infinitive.
questions.translation: El cliente me pidió que enviara el resumen antes del mediodía.

questions.question: The manager said, “Don’t forward this email.” The manager told us ___ that email.
questions.explanation: Las órdenes negativas se forman con tell + persona + not to + verbo.
questions.translation: El responsable nos dijo que no reenviáramos ese correo.

questions.question: The coordinator said to Leo, “Could you check the attendee list?” The coordinator asked Leo ___ the attendee list.
questions.explanation: Una petición con Could you...? puede pasar a ask + persona + to-infinitive.
questions.translation: La coordinadora pidió a Leo que comprobara la lista de asistentes.

questions.question: The lead said, “You should wait for written approval.” The lead advised us ___ for written approval.
questions.explanation: Advise puede construirse con persona + to-infinitive: advised us to wait.
questions.translation: La responsable nos aconsejó esperar la aprobación por escrito.

questions.question: Marta said, “Let’s schedule a short follow-up.” Marta suggested ___ a short follow-up.
questions.explanation: Suggest va seguido de gerundio o de una cláusula con that; no usamos suggest to do.
questions.translation: Marta propuso programar una breve reunión de seguimiento.

questions.question: The analyst said, “Remember to attach the timeline.” The analyst reminded me ___ the timeline.
questions.explanation: Remind + persona + to-infinitive se usa para recordar a alguien que haga algo.
questions.translation: El analista me recordó que adjuntara la cronología.

questions.question: The coordinator said, “Don’t forget to invite the customer.” She reminded him ___ the customer.
questions.explanation: Don’t forget to do se transmite como remind someone to do; la acción que debe recordar es invitar.
questions.translation: La coordinadora le recordó que invitara al cliente.

questions.question: The notice said, “You must not share the recording externally.” The notice warned us ___ the recording externally.
questions.explanation: Warn + persona + not to + verbo transmite una advertencia negativa.
questions.translation: El aviso nos advirtió de que no compartiéramos la grabación fuera de la organización.

questions.question: The analyst said, “Yes, I deleted the duplicate draft.” The analyst admitted ___ the duplicate draft.
questions.explanation: Admit va seguido de gerundio: admitted deleting.
questions.translation: El analista admitió haber eliminado el borrador duplicado.

questions.question: The user said, “I didn’t change the notification settings.” The user denied ___ the notification settings.
questions.explanation: Deny va seguido de gerundio: denied changing.
questions.translation: El usuario negó haber cambiado la configuración de las notificaciones.

questions.question: The coordinator said, “I’ll send the agenda by five.” The coordinator promised ___ the agenda by five.
questions.explanation: Promise puede ir seguido de to-infinitive cuando el sujeto promete realizar la acción.
questions.translation: La coordinadora prometió enviar el orden del día antes de las cinco.

questions.question: The specialist said, “I can explain the chart if you like.” The specialist offered ___ the chart.
questions.explanation: Offer va seguido de to-infinitive cuando alguien se ofrece a hacer algo.
questions.translation: El especialista se ofreció a explicar el gráfico.

questions.question: Rita said, “I’m sorry I missed the briefing.” Rita apologized for ___ the briefing.
questions.explanation: Apologize for va seguido de sustantivo o gerundio: apologized for missing.
questions.translation: Rita se disculpó por haberse perdido la reunión informativa.

questions.question: The manager said, “Well done—you completed the review on time.” The manager congratulated us on ___ the review on time.
questions.explanation: Congratulate someone on va seguido de sustantivo o gerundio.
questions.translation: El responsable nos felicitó por completar la revisión a tiempo.

questions.question: The reviewer said to Tom, “You copied the old wording.” The reviewer accused Tom of ___ the old wording.
questions.explanation: Accuse someone of va seguido de gerundio: accused Tom of copying.
questions.translation: La revisora acusó a Tom de haber copiado la redacción anterior.

questions.question: The client said, “I want to review every change personally.” The client insisted on ___ every change personally.
questions.explanation: Insist on va seguido de sustantivo o gerundio: insisted on reviewing.
questions.translation: El cliente insistió en revisar personalmente cada cambio.
